Triage first-touch grading (finding centralized round, 2026-08-20, triage seat session `session_016A4EBi3ky1mjTi6vD2kCvA`): **promote to `pm:queue`**, type Task, scope = the docs half only. Re-verified on `origin/main`: `schema-reference.md:748-755` and the skills page-builder guide still teach `{name,label}` columns on directly-authored `object-grid`, which `ObjectGrid.tsx:1477` silently drops (while `columnIdentity` still ships the dead column name to `$select`). The docs correction needs no ruling — `object-grid`'s contract is already settled (strict `ListColumnSchema`, `field`/`label`) — so fixing the two published examples that actively teach a broken shape is severable; the fold-vs-filter renderer question stays with #5349, and the wider alias-family ruling stays with #5120.
